entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL game preproduction world and visual bible, landscape 1536x1024. Create a coherent production concept board for TrainOracle's new Korean sleep-linked game "꿈손님 여관" (Dream Guest Inn). An intimate explorable miniature fantasy inn at the meeting of a moss forest, pebble stream and moonlit roof; travelers stop after their journeys and reunite over five chapters. Main large central view: compact two-floor cutaway timber inn, exactly six distinct placeable ground-floor floor tiles in a 3-column 2-row room, accessible front entrance path, left round window, back-right little stove, no upper wall hiding characters; right side stream garden; optional roof observatory. Surrounding supporting small panels show same inn by dusk and dawn, and a tiny walkable village overview. Three ORIGINAL extremely simple rounded matte characters: '모루' moss fox muted sage body, two short triangular ears, cream oval muzzle, broad single tail; '도담' pebble turtle cream body, plain smooth slate teal oval shell without pattern; '루미' lamp moth warm cream bean body, two broad rounded pale amber wings, tiny antennae. Tiny black eyes, no fur, no fingers, no intricate clothes, roughly 25% normal illustration detail, iconic readable silhouettes at 64px. High-quality restrained cozy 2.5D orthographic low-poly diorama, shallow clear geometry feasible in a mobile game, soft baked lighting, ivory/moss/teal/warm amber palette, navy twilight outside. No copied Pokemon/Animal Crossing characters, no ornate fantasy epic architecture, no busy particles, no glossy plastic, no photorealism, no medical symbols, no stats or scores. Clean ivory editorial margins. Text only short Korean heading "꿈손님 여관" and small labels "세계관", "저녁", "아침", "작은 마을". This is a visual development board, not a claim of a functioning game. Prioritize a consistent buildable space over a painting.
